work: Poster, animated poster, anniversary logo, badges, merchandise

2.text: The brief came down to two words: prestige, but silly. Then the poster was animated for the screen.

6.text: Seven badges, all in the poster's inflated, candy-like type.

9.text: The type was tested on paper first. These printed studies sat on the desk before the finals.

14.text: Ninety-one official selections. The screening schedules also ran on the cinema's own displays.

18.text: The tees carry their own jokes. A third one reads “This Is My Red Carpet Outfit.”
